diagnosis: Removing same-process archive construction did not lower the peak. The exact CPU failure increased to 828104704 bytes while every non-RSS gate passed. Code-path inspection identifies two whole-archive allocations inside the LayerCake host lifecycle: package loading reads the entire ZIP before reading its 253 MB tensor member, and active-host verification hashes the installed archive with Path.read_bytes before loading it again. The stage profiler did not call active host identity verification and therefore did not reproduce this allocation path.
decision: Do not run the paired CUDA screen. Repair the LayerCake host, not ABI extraction: stream archive hashing, read ZIP members directly from the file, preserve every security validation, and prohibit whole-archive Path.read_bytes during load and verify with focused tests. Bind the LayerCake patch, then rerun the unchanged CPU and CUDA product screens.
claim_boundary: Negative evidence for the first lifecycle repair and authorization for one measured LayerCake package-loader memory repair. No quality, package, threshold, or artifact change is authorized.
